title: People Ops - self notes & manager prep
content:
Context and purpose:
- Working notes for upcoming FY24 Q4 check-in and 1:1 with manager (Alex Chen).
- Rough self-review, goals proposal, and talking points for role development and priorities.

Accomplishments since last review (concise):
- Reduced average time-to-fill for IC roles from 47 -> 34 days by streamlining interview panel scheduling and introducing a panel coordinator rota.
- Launched new onboarding playbook and checklist (pilot with Data infra hires) — onboarding NPS improved from 6.1 -> 7.8 in pilot cohort.
- Rolled out manager calibration templates with Product & Eng; helped retro 12 hiring decisions to align leveling expectations.
- Implemented an offer approval workflow in Greenhouse that reduced legal review back-and-forth by ~20%.

Impact examples (stories I can bring to the review):
- Data infra hiring: prioritized candidate experience, introduced a short tech take-home task (max 2 hours) -> decreased dropout rate between onsites and offers by 18%. Example candidate feedback available in JIRA-PO-3421.
- Onboarding revamp: added first-30-day milestones for hiring managers and buddies; one manager reported faster time-to-first-PR for new engineers (from ~28 days to ~17 days).

Areas for improvement / things I would own next:
- Formalize manager training for interview calibration across all eng orgs (scale the pilot template). Metric: run 2 live calibration sessions and measure inter-rater variance on leveling for 50 hires.
- Better hiring forecasting with Product and Eng managers — target: monthly staffing heatmap and hiring runway to reduce reactive rush-hiring.
- Improve offer acceptance rate for senior ICs by standardizing compensation justification memos.

Proposed goals (OKR-style) for next 6 months:
- Goal: Decrease company-wide median time-to-fill to 30 days.
  - Success metrics: median time-to-fill <= 30, 80% of requisitions with panel coordinators assigned within 3 days.
- Goal: Increase onboarding quality for remote hires.
  - Success metrics: onboarding NPS >= 8.0 for Q1 cohorts; time-to-first-meaningful-contribution down 25%.
- Goal: Standardize manager hiring calibration.
  - Success metrics: deliver 4 calibration workshops; achieve 90% manager satisfaction "useful" score on post-workshop survey.

Self-reflection / growth areas:
- Strengths: process orientation, cross-functional collaboration, ship small but high-impact changes quickly.
- Areas to grow: deeper partnering on compensation strategy (want to shadow Priya on 2 comp cycles), stronger analytics (want to build out a small dashboard in Looker for hiring trends).
- Leadership stretch: run a cross-functional postmortem playbook for hires that fall through after offer.

Feedback I want from manager (questions to prepare for 1:1):
- Are these proposed goals aligned with team priorities and company roadmap? Any critical gaps?
- Where should I prioritize: reducing time-to-fill vs improving offer acceptance rate vs onboarding quality?
- What exposure should I get to comp strategy conversations this cycle? Any specific stakeholder introductions you recommend?
- How do you see my readiness for Sr People Ops (IC4) responsibilities? What signals should I demonstrate?

Risks / blockers I want to call out:
- Hiring pipeline volatility for Q4 may require flexible capacity — need manager support to request temporary recruiting vendor for 8 weeks if pipeline stalls.
- Limited analytics resources: current Looker access is partial; need engineering time to finalize hiring dashboard (estimate 2 sprints).

Meeting agenda (for 30 min):
1) Quick wins since last review (3-4 bullets) — 3 min
2) Review proposed goals and get alignment — 12 min
3) Career development and comp exposure ask — 8 min
4) Blockers and support requests — 5 min

Notes / talking points (script-style):
- Opening: "Wanted to share a concise set of proposed goals and tradeoffs so we can align quickly. The top priority I want to deliver is improving time-to-fill while guarding for offer quality and candidate experience."
- Data-driven ask: share 3 metrics (current med TTF, onboarding NPS, offer acceptance %) and propose thresholds.
- Career ask: "Would like to be looped into the next comp calibration meeting and shadow Priya Nair on comp decisions for at least 2 senior offers."

Follow-ups after meeting (to self):
- Convert agreed goals into GH tickets and link to team roadmap.
- Book alignment session with Eng recruiting lead to get monthly staffing heatmap template ready.
- Request 2 sprints of analytics support or deprioritize dashboard features accordingly.

Misc scratchpad (quick ideas and links):
- Consider small experiment: post-offer acceptance packet with personalized onboarding agenda + manager video note -> hypothesis: increases acceptance & decays early dropouts.
- Draft email template for manager to send first-week welcome note (short, with 3 quick expectations).
- Link to current onboarding playbook: CONFLUENCE-people-ops/onboarding-playbook

TODO (short):
- [ ] Finalize goal wording and share draft with Priya (by 2024-11-22)
- [ ] Export pilot onboarding NPS raw data and attach to review slides
- [ ] Schedule calibration pilot with Eng managers (target: Dec week 2)

Quick personal note: feeling motivated — want more ownership of cross-functional programs and a clearer path to Sr. People Ops in next 12 months.
